Limitations Despite the promising results demonstrated in this paper, there are several limitations to our framework. • The first step of our framework involves generating an initial answer, which may be highly dependent on the task at hand. For different tasks, the model may struggle to generate a meaningful or useful initial answer, limiting its applicability across diverse problem domains. • Our approach assumes that complex questions can be broken down into simpler ones. However, if these sources do not contain the necessary information for correction, or if they contain misinformation, our framework’s effectiveness could be compromised.
